cleaned.title: Mass shooting in South Africa kills 11

sentences.text: At least 11 people were killed and three others injured when three gunmen opened fire on a house party in KwaMakhutha township near Durban, police said.
Among the dead was a pregnant woman, and two people survived the attack.
The assailants herded everyone into a single room before opening fire and set fire to a vehicle belonging to one of the victims, local broadcaster eNCA reported.
Police have launched a manhunt for the suspects and are combing the scene for evidence, while the motive remains unclear but a feud between rival groupings cannot be ruled out.
One resident likened the scene to something out of a film, telling eNCA, 'I can’t believe it. It’s like a movie'.
